resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record and firelookout.com list the National Park Service / Grand Teton NP. The climbing guide and the NRHP form say the Forest Service began the lookouts in the 1930s, and the 1951 item shows Park Service staff by then. Both are true at different times; the sources do not explain the change.

sources.title: Huckleberry Lookout, National Register of Historic Places nomination form

notes_for_editor: The climbing guide and the NRHP form give only 'the 1930s' for construction, so no build event is recorded. Elevation 7694 ft (about 2,345 m) per firelookout.com; the record has none. Removal date and cause unknown. The guide asks for pictures of the footings only; none found in our reads. The 1951 date comes from a Rigby Star item quoted on westlookouts.weebly.com, not the newspaper itself.
